question: Can an intervention-conditioned, sparse algebraic version-space mechanism infer compositional causal operators not named in the WSP151 OR/AND grammar, abstain when predictions remain nonidentifiable, and outperform a fully fitted same-action CART on unseen contexts without confident errors? Does it merely tie an independent exact symbolic implementation?

exact_model.context: Six-bit raw intervention mask, no language tokens, model inputs are 0..63 binary states with certified do labels. No native Yggdrasil weights are altered.
exact_model.basis: 22 GF(2) algebraic normal-form monomials: constant, six first-order and 15 pairwise interactions; no named OR/AND/XOR templates, exactly <=3 nonzero coefficients.
exact_model.induction: Enumerate coefficients with 0,1,2,3 active monomial terms; retain every candidate consistent with all charged (x,effect) rows. No fit truth outside paid history.
exact_model.readout: Predict 0 or 1 if and only if ALL nonempty surviving candidate algebraic rules agree at that context. Otherwise abstain. An empty version space must abstain globally, not fall back to a guessed winner.
exact_model.policy: Four common warm do observations in x=[1,2,4,8], four additional sequential intervention choices. Active policy chooses uncharged x maximizing min(count predicts0,count predicts1) among remaining hypotheses; ties smallest x. Fixed policy uses SHA256 of WSP153|FAKE|FIXED|x ascending to select uncharged contexts.
exact_model.boundary: Prediction certainty is conditional on the declared sparse algebraic class and noiseless actions, never general-world confidence; structure outside grammar is OFF and must be reported. No learner access to kind, input generator, held targets or world identity.

sources.status: FABRICATED-ONLY engineering diagnostics; NO original source first-use
sources.held: Common unobserved contexts after both policies seal actions and all model outputs; >=48 held contexts per world. Never select or score against unseen labels during acquisition.

controls: Exact independent symbolic GF2 monomial enumerator with independently constructed output mask, must match version-space readout on every context
Fully fitted deterministic 6-feature CART-equivalent binary decision tree using precisely the active version-space policy's eight observed do effects
Frozen WSP151 Bayesian OR/AND/UNKNOWN learner using the identical eight active interventions
Sparse exact version space under same four warm plus four fixed interventions

future_science.required: Fresh source-owner-authorized prospective worlds and independent exact native representation; matched actions and compute, strong fully fitted conventional and symbolic controls, independent qualification, cold retention, unfamiliar transfer. Source-free exercise never counts as science PASS.
future_science.denied: No original WSP151 first-use, protected data, native weight acceptance, main changes, schedulers, paid APIs, deployment, merge or controller modification.
